stories.title: Anthropic closes first day of public trading at $1.3tn valuation after largest-ever IPO
summary: AI startup and Claude chatbot maker became one of the world’s most valuable publicly traded businesses with final share price of $97Anthropic closed its first day of trading on the US stock market about 17% higher than its initial public offering price.

At the close of market on Thursday, Anthropic shares were trading at just over $97 with a nearly $1.3tn total market capitalization, $1.75tn fully diluted.While the final share value was higher than the IPO price of $83, it marked a dip from an early high of $111.50.
The firm’s shares initially soared 34% when trading got under way on its US market debut on Thursday, valuing the company at more than $2tn.

stories.title: Launch HN: Onlook (YC W25) – An open-source developer tool for designers
summary: Hey HN, I'm Daniel, founder of Onlook (https://github.com/onlook-dev/onlook and onlook.com).Onlook is a desktop app that puts a canvas on top of your real codebase, letting you design directly in code with the agent you already use.
Onlook gives designers a familiar canvas while managing all of the dev processes that get between them and making mind-blowing designs in code.

Design tools used to be limited to a proprietary setup or closed schema, but now you can push and pull the medium of code to get whatever result you want, so why not give agents an infinite canvas of browsers and see what they do?
